scope: Post-publication geometry-lint review of four revised printable pieces; every lint class ran once against the published full-resolution STL.
execution: The thin-class normal-matrix and pair batches were bounded without changing samples, predicates or thresholds; surface classes ran unchanged. No build or commit checks added.

results.foam-cap-top: No step, bump, sliver, ceiling, slope or ledge findings. Thin rankings are the retained 2 mm floor and 2.38 mm casing; the curved-passage rim findings are absent.
results.foam-cap-lid-top: No new surface feature defect. Six named functional ceilings retain their recorded pocket/tie roles. Thin rankings locate existing clamp-head floors, the perimeter screw clearances, C2 spring jaws and the unchanged B-fill cover.
results.reservoir-cap-left: Six counterbore bearing faces and the flush B-draw spool perimeter lip. Thin ranking locates the existing rod register and the matching spool-seat/perimeter interface.
results.reservoir-cap-right: Six counterbore bearing faces and the flush vent/fill spool perimeter lips. Thin ranking locates the existing rod register.

print_release: B-fill layout remains unresolved. The top lid is not released for a production print.
